stem.text: A uniform electric field is created by two parallel vertical plates. A positively charged particle is in the vacuum between the plates, as shown.

stem.alt: Two parallel vertical plates: the left plate has negative signs (−) beside it and the right plate has positive signs (+) beside it. A horizontal line crosses both plates. Between the plates, a label reading positively charged particle points to a small dot.

A.text: The electric field makes the particle move towards the negative plate with a constant speed.

B.text: The electric field makes the particle move towards the negative plate with a constant acceleration.

C.text: The electric field produces a uniform rate of decrease in the particle’s acceleration.

D.text: The electric field produces a uniform rate of increase in the particle’s acceleration.
